newsitem.title: BURMA: Rangoon papers hail visit by Thai Prime Minister.
newsitem.headline: Rangoon papers hail visit by Thai Prime Minister.

text.p: State-owned Burmese newspapers on Saturday hailed Thai Prime Minister Chavalit Yongchaiyudh's one-day visit to Burma as a step towards boosting relations.
The New Light of Myanmar said Chavalit's visit had moved Thai-Burmese friendship up a notch.

"Short as his stay may be, the goodwill delegation and the Myanmar (Burma) side were able to sign an agreement on border crossing between the two countries and exchange notes on jurisdiction over the Thai-Myanmar Friendship Bridge on the Moei/Thaungyin River," it added.
Burmese Minister for Immigration and Population Maung Hla and Thai Foreign Minister Prachuab Chaiyasan signed the agreements on Friday.
"The two important documents will facilitate better border trade, removing whatever snags that might have occurred earlier in the absence of such documents," the newspaper said.

"The Thais understand Myanmar's position full well, just as other friends do. We have much in common and a consensus is always obtained when friends meet, thus further strengthening already strong ties...," it added.
